_note: Settings for the recorded morning podcast. 'engine': 'azure' (natural Microsoft voices, used when the AZURE_SPEECH_KEY secret is set) or 'kokoro' (free voice that runs on GitHub). 'azure_voice' e.g. en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural. 'voice' is the Kokoro voice, also used as the backup. 'speed': 1.0 is normal. 'topics': which topics are read, in this order. 'host_style': with an Anthropic API key, Claude rewrites the script as a casual, witty host. 'enabled': false turns the recording off.
